description: Vietnam: Scenarios for Solar PV Deployment is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Renewable energy, Solar", published or maintained by Oliver Knight and Clara Ivanescu (World Bank Group). The result of a geospatial analysis performed by the World Bank for assessing Vietnam’s potential for solar PV deployment, ground mounting and floating. The analysis was performed using the MapRE tool and methodology developed by Berkley ( and it made use of high accuracy Land Use/Land Cover data acquired from the client country. Coverage: Vietnam. It has 2 files in ZIP, XLS. The portal files it under Renewable energy, Solar. The portal gives 2018 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
